description:
The Census Bureau's 2020 urban area delineation: all **2,644** urban areas in the United States and Puerto Rico, from [TIGER/Line 2024 `UAC20`](https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2024/UAC20/) — one national file. For the 2020 Census the Bureau replaced the 2010 urbanized-area/urban-cluster split with a single urban area definition: every feature here carries the same MTFCC, `G3500` ("Urban Area"), decoded into `feature_type`. **Deviation from the original brief:** this means there is no urban/rural class column (`UATYPE20`, from the 2010 product) to style on — it does not exist in `UAC20` — so the default style classes on land area instead; see the collection's processing notes.

`aland_sqkm` and `awater_sqkm` are `ALAND20`/`AWATER20` converted from square meters. Geometry keeps the source CRS (NAD83, EPSG:4269) rather than being reprojected to WGS84.

The PMTiles archive is a single band at full resolution, built with [tylertoo](https://github.com/geoparquet-io/tylertoo) `tiles` (not `pyramid` — there is no coarser geography to step up to below this collection, so every zoom draws this collection's own features, thinned to fit the tile-size cap where a zoom is too dense to draw in full). Statistics come from the GeoParquet; this collection has no `*_moe` columns to exclude.

This is a mirror — [data.census.gov](https://data.census.gov/) is authoritative, and nothing here is an official Census Bureau product. The exact upstream files this collection was built from are published as `source` assets, linked at their original census.gov URLs, so the original is always one click away; the Bureau's own documentation is linked alongside them. Read the collection's [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before querying: it carries the schema, the join keys, the NULL-rate story and tested queries against the published URLs.

providers.name: U.S. Census Bureau
providers.description: Produces the American Community Survey, the Decennial Census, and the TIGER/cartographic boundary geographies this catalog is built from.

urban-areas-tiles.title: 2020 Urban Areas (PMTiles)
urban-areas-tiles.description: Vector tiles rendered from the collection's GeoParquet for map display, layer 'urban-areas'. The collection description states what each zoom band carries.

urban-areas.title: 2020 Urban Areas (GeoParquet, national)
urban-areas.description: GeoParquet with the collection's features and attributes. Every column carries a description in this collection's table:columns.

thumbnail.title: 2020 Urban Areas rendered with the default style
thumbnail.description: A rendered card of the collection's own data, drawn with the default style.

styles/default.title: Land area
styles/default.description: Land area in square kilometres, pale to deep purple, roughly logarithmic so a small city's urban area and a metro area's both get their own class. Measured over all 2,644 urban areas with a published value: 6 classes with breaks at 10/25/75/250/750 km², which fall at the 19th/57th/81st/93rd/98th percentile of the national distribution.

source-uac20.title: TIGER/Line 2024 UAC20 — 2020 urban areas, national file
source-uac20.description: The one national shapefile this collection's 2,644 features were read from.

doc-mtfcc.title: 2022 MAF/TIGER Feature Class Code Definitions
doc-mtfcc.description: The code -> name table `feature_type` was decoded from. TIGER2024 has no 2024 edition of this PDF; 2022 is the nearest published vintage, linked from the Bureau's own index at https://www.census.gov/library/reference/code-lists/mt-feature-class-codes.html. The code set is unchanged between the two: every code this build used also appears, worded the same, in the 2021 and 2025 editions.

table:columns.name: mtfcc
table:columns.description: `MTFCC20`. Always `G3500` (measured over all 2,644 rows) -- the 2020 Census urban area product has no urban/urbanized split, unlike its 2010 predecessor.

table:columns.name: feature_type
table:columns.description: `mtfcc` decoded through the 2022 MAF/TIGER Feature Class Code list. Always "Urban Area".

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Urban area boundary polygon, WKB-encoded. Written in the source CRS, NAD83 (EPSG:4269) -- unlike the ACS collections, this is kept rather than reprojected to WGS84/OGC:CRS84, so the GeoParquet `geo` metadata carries an explicit `crs` key.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: GeoParquet 1.1 covering struct for the row's geometry, written by gpio, with row-group statistics.
